Topic 8.5: Play simple

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Play simple. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. play simple musical instruments for enjoyment
2. display ability to play various simple musical instruments including ICT device
3. play simple instruments and make movement for talent development other in operating the gadgets. safety and care of the gadgets. Core-Competence 108

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. play simple musical instruments for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to play simple musical instruments for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. display ability to play various simple musical instruments including ICT device
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to display ability to play various simple musical instruments including ICT device. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. play simple instruments and make movement for talent development other in operating the gadgets. safety and care of the gadgets. Core-Competence 108
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to play simple instruments and make movement for talent development other in operating the gadgets. safety and care of the gadgets. Core-Competence 108. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
